name: @ryu/workflows-app
description: The Ryu Workflows app: a React Flow DAG canvas (node editing across all kinds, CRUD, versions, run + run-state, triggers, templates, ghost record→replay) shipped as a full-page Companion (Path B, ui_format:"html").
